apiKey.title: SMTPing API key
apiKey.description: Your API key from app.smtping.com. Every account gets 25 free credits per day, no card required.

emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: One address per line. Duplicates and malformed lines are removed.

fileUrl.title: List URL (CSV or TXT)
fileUrl.description: Optional public URL of a CSV or TXT file. Every email address found in it is checked.

outputFilter.title: Rows to keep
outputFilter.description: matched = only complainer hits. clean = only addresses with no match. all = everything.
